questions.q: What is the full form of KYC?
questions.explain: KYC stands for Know Your Customer — a mandatory bank verification process.

questions.q: What is the Repo Rate (as of 2025)?
questions.explain: RBI's repo rate was 6.25% in 2025 after multiple cuts.

questions.q: Which bank is the largest public sector bank in India?
questions.explain: SBI is India's largest public sector bank by assets and branches.

questions.q: What is NPA in banking?
questions.explain: NPA is a loan or advance where the borrower has stopped paying interest or principal.

questions.q: What is the full form of NEFT?
questions.explain: NEFT stands for National Electronic Funds Transfer.

questions.q: Which organization regulates banking in India?
questions.explain: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) regulates banking in India.

questions.q: What is a mutual fund?
questions.explain: A mutual fund pools money from investors to buy securities, managed by professionals.

questions.q: What is the full form of SIP?
questions.explain: SIP stands for Systematic Investment Plan — a way to invest in mutual funds regularly.

questions.q: Which insurance company is the largest in India?
questions.explain: Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) is India's largest insurance company.

questions.q: What is the full form of UPI?
questions.explain: UPI stands for Unified Payments Interface — instant real-time payment system.

questions.q: What is a credit score range in India?
questions.explain: Credit score in India ranges from 300 to 900 (CIBIL score).

questions.q: Which bank introduced the concept of zero-balance accounts in India?
questions.explain: Jan Dhan Yojana (2014) introduced zero-balance accounts across banks.

questions.q: What is IMPS?
questions.explain: IMPS stands for Immediate Payment Service — 24x7 interbank electronic fund transfer.

questions.q: What is the full form of CRR?
questions.explain: CRR is the percentage of deposits banks must keep with RBI.

questions.q: Which bank launched the YONO app?
questions.explain: SBI launched YONO (You Need Only One) — a digital banking platform.

questions.q: What is a Demat account?
questions.explain: A Demat account holds shares and securities in electronic form.

questions.q: What is the full form of SLR?
questions.explain: SLR is the percentage of deposits banks must maintain in liquid assets.

questions.q: Which digital payment app is owned by NPCI?
questions.explain: BHIM (Bharat Interface for Money) is developed by NPCI.

questions.q: What is the full form of DICGC?
options: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation
questions.explain: DICGC insures bank deposits up to Rs 5 lakh per depositor per bank.

questions.q: What is a gold loan?
questions.explain: A gold loan is a secured loan where gold ornaments are used as collateral.
